items.label: D
items.recommendation: Because the device malfunction directly led to the death of a patient, the event constitutes a serious incident pursuant to Article 2(65)(a). In accordance with Article 87, the manufacturer must submit a report to the competent authority of the Member State in which the incident occurred immediately after establishing or suspecting a causal relationship between the device and the incident, but not later than 10 days after becoming aware of it. If necessary to ensure timely compliance, the manufacturer may submit an initial incomplete report followed by a complete report. Even if uncertainty exists regarding reportability, a report must nevertheless be submitted within the mandatory timeframe, and appropriate follow-up action must be taken in accordance with Article 89.
